head.name: Head
head.defined_meaning: Consistent pressure to inspire, question, and conceptualize.
head.open_meaning: Amplifies mental pressure from the environment and samples inspiration.

ajna.name: Ajna
ajna.defined_meaning: Reliable way of processing concepts and forming perspective.
ajna.open_meaning: Flexible mind that can see many viewpoints without needing certainty.

throat.name: Throat
throat.defined_meaning: Consistent way of expressing, manifesting, or making energy visible.
throat.open_meaning: Variable expression; wisdom grows by noticing when to speak and when not to.

g.name: G Center
g.defined_meaning: Stable identity, direction, and love signature.
g.open_meaning: Fluid identity and direction; thrives in correct people and places.

ego.name: Ego / Heart
ego.defined_meaning: Consistent willpower, value, and capacity to commit resources.
ego.open_meaning: Inconsistent willpower; wisdom comes from not forcing proof or promises.

spleen.name: Spleen
spleen.defined_meaning: Stable instinct, immunity, and body awareness in the present.
spleen.open_meaning: Sensitive to fear and wellbeing of others; learns what is healthy to release.

solar.name: Solar Plexus
solar.defined_meaning: Consistent emotional wave and depth of feeling over time.
solar.open_meaning: Amplifies emotions from others; clarity comes by not avoiding feeling.

sacral.name: Sacral
sacral.defined_meaning: Sustainable life-force, work energy, and response capacity.
sacral.open_meaning: Variable access to workforce energy; wisdom lies in rest and discernment.

root.name: Root
root.defined_meaning: Steady pressure to start, evolve, and move through stress.
root.open_meaning: Amplifies stress pressure; mastery comes from pacing instead of rushing.
